<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400" width="600" height="400">
  <rect width="600" height="400" fill="#eef6fb"/>
  <rect y="320" width="600" height="80" fill="#d9d2c5"/>

  <!-- 背景装饰 -->
  <circle cx="520" cy="70" r="30" fill="#ffd76e"/>
  <ellipse cx="120" cy="90" rx="50" ry="16" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="180" cy="110" rx="40" ry="12" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- 整车左右移动 -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 40 0; 0 0" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- 后轮 -->
    <g transform="translate(190 300)">
      <circle r="48" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="6"/>
      <circle r="6" fill="#333"/>
      <g stroke="#888" stroke-width="3">
        <line x1="0" y1="-44" x2="0" y2="44"/>
        <line x1="-44" y1="0" x2="44" y2="0"/>
        <line x1="-31" y1="-31" x2="31" y2="31"/>
        <line x1="-31" y1="31" x2="31" y2="-31"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- 前轮 -->
    <g transform="translate(410 300)">
      <circle r="48" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="6"/>
      <circle r="6" fill="#333"/>
      <g stroke="#888" stroke-width="3">
        <line x1="0" y1="-44" x2="0" y2="44"/>
        <line x1="-44" y1="0" x2="44" y2="0"/>
        <line x1="-31" y1="-31" x2="31" y2="31"/>
        <line x1="-31" y1="31" x2="31" y2="-31"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- 车架 -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#e05a3a" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="190" y1="300" x2="275" y2="220"/>
      <line x1="275" y1="220" x2="375" y2="220"/>
      <line x1="375" y1="220" x2="410" y2="300"/>
      <line x1="275" y1="220" x2="300" y2="300"/>
      <line x1="190" y1="300" x2="300" y2="300"/>
      <line x1="375" y1="220" x2="365" y2="190"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 车把 -->
    <line x1="365" y1="190" x2="350" y2="165" stroke="#e05a3a" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- 座椅 -->
    <line x1="262" y1="215" x2="285" y2="215" stroke="#333" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- 脚踏 -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="300" r="10" fill="#333"/>

    <!-- 鹈鹕 -->
    <g>
      <!-- 身体 -->
      <ellipse cx="300" cy="175" rx="52" ry="32" fill="#f7f7f2" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- 腿 -->
      <line x1="300" y1="200" x2="310" y2="240" stroke="#f0a832" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="310" y1="240" x2="298" y2="295" stroke="#f0a832" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 310 240; 25 310 240; 0 310 240" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </line>
      <!-- 翅膀 -->
      <ellipse cx="295" cy="175" rx="26" ry="16" fill="#e8e8e0" transform="rotate(-15 295 175)"/>
      <!-- 脖子+头 -->
      <path d="M335 165 C 360 130, 370 120, 368 100" fill="none" stroke="#f7f7f2" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="368" cy="98" r="17" fill="#f7f7f2" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- 大嘴 -->
      <path d="M375 100 L 430 112 L 375 118 Z" fill="#f0a832"/>
      <!-- 眼睛 -->
      <circle cx="372" cy="92" r="3" fill="#222"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
